_about: Observed digests for the datasets in sources.json.
records what it actually downloaded. Nothing in this file is written by
hand, and an entry that is not here has not been verified by anyone.
`archive` is the digest of the bytes served at the URL. `members` holds
the digest of each extracted file the loader reads, so a re-zipped
archive with the same contents still verifies at the member level.
`pinned_at` is the UTC date of the fetch that recorded the entry and
`pinned_by` is the value of MOJOBOOST_BENCH_PINNER or the hostname.
When a pin stops matching, the dataset changed underneath us. That is a
finding, not a nuisance: record the new digest as a second entry under
`superseded` and say which results used which.
